title: Ensuring Ageing Private Estates and Commercial Buildings are Properly Maintained
what_it_is: Ensuring Ageing Private Estates and Commercial Buildings are Properly Maintained

sections.label: Maintenance of private estates
sections.summary: The question asks how the Ministry ensures ageing private estates and commercial buildings are maintained, measures for recalcitrant owners or managing agents, and whether a rating framework will be implemented.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong
sentences.text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) how does the Ministry ensure that ageing private estates and commercial buildings are properly maintained as to their structure, fire safety, electricity and water supplies, refuse disposal and pest control, for the well-being of occupants and visitors; (b) what are the measures to deal with recalcitrant owners or managing agents; and (c) whether the Ministry will implement a rating framework for private estates similar to that for Town Councils to ensure that the quality of private estate management matches that of public estates.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: There are legislative or regulatory requirements currently in place.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For example, the Building and Construction Authority (BCA) requires building owners to appoint a professional engineer to inspect the building on a regular basis and to rectify any structural defects that are found.

sections.label: Accredited Managing Agent scheme
sections.summary: An Accredited MA scheme administered by SISV and APFM ensures quality, and many MAs have termination clauses, so ranking every MA is not fair or feasible.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: To ensure quality, we have got an Accredited MA (AMA) scheme, which is administered by both the Singapore Institute of Surveyors and Valuers (SISV), and the Association of Property and Facility Managers (APFM).

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: For many MAs, you also have termination clauses if they are not performing, too.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: So, it is not fair or feasible to rank every MA out there because, by firm, some may qualify.

sections.label: AMA scheme accredits MAs
sections.summary: The AMA scheme accredits managing agents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: As I mentioned earlier, we have the AMA scheme which accredits MAs.

sections.label: Procurement, KPIs and accreditation awareness
sections.summary: Procurement allows termination if KPIs are not met, expectations should be set upfront, ranking may work at firm level but not on the ground, and condos can be kept aware of accredited MAs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: In terms of procurement, you have the option of terminating if they do not meet certain key performance indicators (KPIs).

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: It is important to set the expectations upfront before you procure the services, and set what are the requirements, what are the specifications, that the MAs need to fulfil.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: The challenge is, again, ranking may work at the firm level, but it does not necessarily work on the ground.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: But really, if the condos would like to have some sense of which ones are accredited, perhaps if the AMA scheme is not well-known, then we can certainly work to keep condos more aware of what are the accredited MAs out there.
